mechanics.summary: Existing native ad placement in the home feed, below the first story: a sponsored card labeled Ad (Taboola in the 09-28 capture). Fill varies: the same slot was empty (just an AD label) 7 minutes later.

open_questions: No paywall, limit, or currency was seen on the home feed.
Which network fills the feed ad slot varies by session (Taboola on 09-28, direct cards on 09-27), and it is sometimes empty.
